note: The demo-run/ paths were scratch paths and were removed after recording; substitute your own output directory when rerunning the commands.

environment.jianying: 剪映专业版 10.1.0 installed at /Applications/VideoFusion-macOS.app (bundle com.lemon.lvpro). 10.1 keeps the timeline in an encrypted draft_info.json, so the exported plaintext 5.x/6.x schema was never live-imported into that install.

input.description: Twelve 5-second stills with alternating dark/bright backgrounds and a scene label plus timecode, encoded to H.264 and concatenated. No audio track.
generation: magick -size 540x960 xc:#<scene-color> -font Helvetica-Bold -pointsize 58 -gravity center -annotate +0-40 'SCENE NN' -pointsize 30 -annotate +0+40 '00:00:SS:00' frames/sceneNN.png
ffmpeg -loop 1 -t 5 -i frames/sceneNN.png -vf fps=30,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 20 parts/partNN.mp4
input.note: The shell loop that ran these commands is not shipped. Alternating luminance guarantees every hard cut is a large content change, so the 12 manual cuts are also the expected detector output.

composition: 0.0-2.5s: the synthetic 60s clip played at 24x with a step label

verification.lint: ruff check . and ruff format --check . pass
jianying_tests: caption track and text material counts
canvas follows the platform aspect ratio
default draft names and ids include platform and aspect, so Douyin and Xiaohongshu exports do not collide
29.97 fps tc_out converts through the real frame rate
rerunning the same export produces byte-identical JSON
no text track when no captions exist
CLI dry-run writes nothing; CLI export writes the root layout
an existing root_meta_info.json is merged by draft id; a different draft folder is not overwritten
web_tests: opening an existing shots.json points PUT /sheet at that file and edits land on disk
a missing path, malformed JSON, or not-a-sheet JSON is rejected with a clear message
the A4 sheet prints 12 shots on one page in headless Chrome

limitations: 剪映专业版 10.1 stores drafts in an encrypted draft_info.json. This exporter writes the plaintext draft_content.json format (version 360000, new_version 75.0.0) used by 剪映专业版 5.x/6.x and does not write or decrypt draft_info.json.

剪映专业版 10.1.0 is installed, but it stores the timeline in an encrypted draft_info.json and reads no plaintext draft_content.json. The exported 5.x/6.x schema was therefore never live-imported, and the m3 acceptance (live import, per-cut error <200 ms) remains UNVERIFIED.
The draft's material path is the absolute --video path when supplied. Moving the draft folder requires relinking the clip, which is normal for 剪映 drafts.
The synthetic clip has no audio, so ASR was not run and this recording has no caption text track. Caption segment export is covered by unit tests with hand-authored captions.
Vision fields are empty because no ARK_API_KEY/DASHSCOPE_API_KEY was used. The describe pipeline is covered by offline tests with a mocked provider.

The input clip is synthetic; scene detection found exactly 12 cuts because the cuts are high-contrast hard cuts. Real footage may produce a different count, and the tool warns when a clip yields a single shot.
The GIF is a montage of real artifacts, not a screen recording of the web UI.

On macOS, loading scenedetect/PyAV alongside the system libavdevice can print duplicate Objective-C class warnings (objc[...]: Class ... is implemented in both ...). They are harmless library-loading notices, not analysis failures.
unverified: m3 acceptance: live import of the exported draft into a running 剪映专业版 was not performed; UNVERIFIED.
m3 acceptance: per-cut error <200 ms against the editor timeline was not measured; UNVERIFIED.
